data.overview: ParfumsMoinsChers.com is a French online discount perfumery selling what it describes as 100% authentic branded fragrances at reduced prices, claiming 250,000 French customers and over 4,500-5,000 references. The fetched sources provide no independent brand-specific evidence on safety, sustainability, or ethics; the only self-published claims relate to product authenticity. No fetched source establishes a parent-company relationship for this specific brand.

claims.claim: The brand states it sells only genuine, authentic branded perfumes and never imitations.
claims.quote: Nous tenons à préciser que tous nos parfums sont neufs et 100% Authentiques. Les imitations ne font pas parties de nos stocks.
